blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Motorists will have to brace for another round of gasoline price increases on Tuesday, while diesel products will see a slight reduction. In an advisory, Shell Pilipinas said gasoline prices would increase by P1.90 per liter. READ: Iran says received US response to its proposal to end war Kerosene will also rise by P3.30 per liter. Diesel, meanwhile, will have a price drop of P1.30 per liter. Other oil firms have yet to announce their price adjustments.
